name: Summarize article URLs with Google Gemini AI from WordPress and blogs
description:
![Thiết kế chưa có tên 22.png](fileId:6381)

This n8n template automates the extraction and summarization of long-form articles, blogs, or WordPress posts using an interactive Chat Interface and Gemini AI. If you like staying informed but want to reduce daily reading time and bypass webpage clutter, *this workflow is perfect for you*.

## How it works

* **Input phase:** You paste an article URL directly into the n8n Chat interface. The workflow verifies the format to ensure it's a valid link.
* **Extraction phase:** The **HTTP Request** node fetches the raw webpage. Then, the **HTML Extract** node acts as a smart filter, stripping away ads, navigation bars, comments, and footers to isolate the pure article text.
* **Summarization phase:** The cleaned content is sent to an **AI Agent** powered by Google Gemini. Guided by a customized system prompt, the AI generates a structured, bulleted summary highlighting the core insights of the article.

## How to use

1.  **Connect credentials:** Link your **Google Gemini** API key in the Chat Model node.
2.  **Test the flow:** Open the "Chat" panel in your n8n workspace.
3.  **Input data:** Paste a blog or news URL and hit send.
4.  **Activate:** Save and activate the workflow to make it permanently accessible.

## Requirements

* **n8n Version:** Built and tested on **n8n 2.9.4+**. *(Note: You may encounter errors on older versions. It is highly recommended to update to the latest n8n version to use this workflow effectively).*
* **Google Gemini API Key:** Required for the AI summarization step.

## Customizing this workflow

* **Change the input source:** Swap the Chat Trigger for a **Telegram Bot** or **Slack** trigger to summarize links directly from your mobile messaging apps.
* **Refine the AI output:** Edit the system prompt inside the AI Agent to change the language, tone, or format (e.g., requesting a 3-sentence summary or a Twitter-ready thread).
* **Store the data:** Add a Google Sheets or Notion node at the end to build a personal knowledge base of all the articles you've summarized.

## Smart WordPress Article Summarizer with AI

This workflow allows you to input a WordPress or blog article URL via a Chat Interface, automatically fetch and clean its content, and generate a smart, concise summary using **Gemini AI**.

All AI interactions are tailored by a custom system prompt ensuring clear, structured outputs.

### How it works
1. **Input:** You submit a URL into the n8n Chat interface.
2. **Validation:** The workflow verifies if the input is a valid HTTP link.
3. **Extraction:** It fetches the raw webpage and intelligently extracts only the main content (removing ads, navbars, footers, etc.).
4. **Summarization:** The extracted text is processed by Gemini AI to produce a bulleted, easy-to-read summary.

### Setup
* [ ] Connect your **Google Gemini** credential in the AI Chat Model node.
* [ ] Open the Chat interface in n8n and paste a URL to test.
* [ ] Activate the workflow.

### Customization tips
* **Change Trigger:** Swap the Chat Trigger for Telegram, Slack, or Zalo to summarize links sent via messaging apps.
* **Adjust AI Tone:** Modify the system prompt inside the AI Summarizer node to fit your specific reading preferences.

### LICENCE
This template is shared free of charge. Copyright belongs to Nguyen Thieu Toan. Any copying or modification must credit the author.

## Section 1: Input & Validation
Receives input from the chat interface, assigns the value to a variable, and verifies that the input starts with 'http' before proceeding.

## Section 2: Fetch & Clean Content
Downloads the webpage's raw HTML and uses CSS selectors to strip away noise (ads, navbars, footers), isolating the main article text.

## Section 3: AI Summarization
Passes the cleaned text to the AI Agent powered by Gemini. The agent is prompted to act as a professional summarizer, delivering structured, bulleted insights.

## ⚠️ Important!

The **Google Gemini Chat Model** requires a valid `googlePalmApi` credential. Please connect your API key before chatting.
